executedBuild.decodeScope: File VAD admission plus ASR stream processing for admitted fixtures. Excludes file reads and model loads.
executedBuild.loadScope: Native recognizer construction after JNI runtime identification.
executedBuild.streamingScope: Unpaced simulation from file chunks. Audio timestamps count fixture audio supplied, and compute timestamps measure elapsed processing time. Both first nonempty fields are omitted when no nonblank partial is observed before flush, including when the first text appears during flush.
executedBuild.memoryScope: Snapshots of the entire target process PSS, in KiB. Includes instrumentation and both shared and private allocations. These are not isolated model memory or peak measurements.

vad.scope: Unpaced full-file speech admission before ASR. Admitted audio is decoded unchanged. Suppressed fixtures never invoke ASR.
